subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI composer dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature after this branch is ported and proven, or should the work stay under the broader WebChat voice tracker?
rationale: The change adds a new user-facing microphone workflow and authenticated Gateway audio method, so implementation fixes alone do not settle the product/security boundary.

options.title: Accept Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
options.body: Port the UI to current main, fix the review blockers, require proof, and then review the core Gateway method as the preferred batch-dictation direction.

options.title: Keep only the broad voice tracker
options.body: Do not land this PR until maintainers decide the broader STT/TTS WebChat direction in the canonical voice issue.

options.title: Defer to Talk transcription UX
options.body: Use transcription-only Talk or existing media attachment paths for now and avoid adding a separate composer-native dictation method.

recommendation.title: Accept Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
recommendation.body: Port the UI to current main, fix the review blockers, require proof, and then review the core Gateway method as the preferred batch-dictation direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the previous server-side dictation slice and relevant media helper history, making him the strongest available routing owner for the product boundary.
